ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Highly skewed distribution with approximately 92% low-intensity (dark) pixels and 8% high-intensity (white/light gray) pixels localized to surface markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark-gray/black substrate covering the entire visible fluke. High-contrast white features are mapped as discrete, non-contiguous circular rings and points scattered semi-randomly across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep acute V-shaped depression at central axis, estimated at approximately 50 degrees with a clear vertical cleft extending downward.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extreme irregular serration with high-amplitude peaks and deep valleys across the entire trailing edge boundary; largest jagged indentations located on the distal third of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Primary convex curve from notch to tips, exhibiting a secondary upward concave trend at the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density distribution of circular and annular white pixel clusters (5-20 pixel diameter) concentrated in the medial and distal regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned linear white pixel disruptions visible on the right lobe, primarily oriented in near-vertical trajectories.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive macro-serration and irregular tissue loss along the trailing edge; clustered white calcified protrusions present at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive ring-shaped pigmentation patterns (hollow circles) distributed across the dark ventral surface.
